_comment: PAN AND ZOOM, the Layer 2 camera move in the Narrative Diversity pane. Generated by tools/build_pan_and_zoom.py from the pz_*.html renders in assets/bench/pan_and_zoom/ - do not edit by hand. Each entry is keyed by the Layer 1 style it composes on top of, and holds the cleaned SVG (narration removed) plus that narration as timed cues, which the page shows in the panel under the animation. A style with no entry has no pan and zoom render yet, and the pane says so rather than offering it.
label: Pan and Zoom
note: Layer 2 pan and zoom composes on top of any of them

cues.text: The pipeline initiates with raw inputs for the comprehensive scene representation.
Inputs include 3D Point Clouds, RGB Images, and Depth Images with Camera Poses.
Step 1: 3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking process begins.
Superpoints are selected and projected into a histogram.
An optimal pivot view is determined based on the histogram data.
SAM 2 Segmentation is applied within the selected pivot view.
This extracts a highly accurate 2D mask in the pivot view.
SAM 2 Tracking utilizes this mask along with 3D spatial cues.
Bidirectional tracking produces a complete 2D Mask Track sequence.
Step 2: 3D Proposal Refinement Via Mask Optimization.
The 2D sequence is lifted to form an initial 3D Mask Candidate.
The candidate is rigorously refined using Algorithm 1 optimization.
A Final 3D Proposal is generated for Class-Agnostic Segmentation.
The class-agnostic 3D instance segments form the structural foundation.
The refined segments are passed to the Output stage for labeling.
Proposals are formally transitioned to the final evaluation models.
CLIP and LLMs provide open-vocab semantic output labels.
Grand Finale: Complete architectural overview of the pipeline.

SAM 2 Segmentation is applied within the selected pivot view.
This extracts a highly accurate 2D mask in the pivot view.
SAM 2 Tracking utilizes this mask along with 3D spatial cues.
Spatial cues actively guide the SAM 2 boundaries.
Bidirectional tracking produces a complete 2D Mask Track sequence.
The complete 2D Mask Sequence is fully assembled.
Step 2: 3D Proposal Refinement Via Mask Optimization.
The 2D sequence is lifted to form an initial 3D Mask Candidate.
The candidate is rigorously refined using Algorithm 1 optimization.
A Final 3D Proposal is generated for Class-Agnostic Segmentation.
The class-agnostic 3D instance segments form the structural foundation.
The refined segments are passed to the Output stage for labeling.
Open-Vocab 3D Instance Segmentation categorizes the data.
Open-Ended 3D Instance Segmentation handles complex semantic bounds.
CLIP processes the visual semantic embeddings.
LLMs provide textual reasoning to support the prediction.
Output labels are finally attached to the components.
